name: 🥤 Power Protein Smoothie
tagline: Thick, cold and fruity, with Greek yogurt and OJ for a breakfast that holds until lunch.

items.name: Ice, if the fruit isn't frozen

steps.text: Pour the OJ into the blender first, then the yogurt.
Add the spinach, banana and frozen berries on top.
Blend on low, then high, until totally smooth.
Taste; add honey if needed. Too thick? A splash more juice.
Pour into 4 glasses and serve right away.

kid_jobs.job: Load the blender in order: liquid, yogurt, greens, fruit
Taste test and decide on honey

chef_tip: Liquids in first, frozen fruit last. The blender won't jam and you need no ice, so it never tastes watered down.
make_ahead: Pack 'smoothie bags' (berries, banana, spinach) in the freezer; dump and blend.
leftovers: Freeze extra in popsicle molds for an after-school snack.
serve_with: A slice of toast or a hard-boiled egg
heads_up: Peel and freeze ripe bananas ahead.

game_plan.what: Optional: freeze smoothie bags of berries, banana, spinach.
OJ into the blender first, then the yogurt.
Kids add spinach, banana and frozen berries.
Blend low, then high, until smooth. Taste; honey if needed.
Pour into 4 glasses and drink right away.
